description: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
readme_excerpt: - **Stay light.** Native Rust + GPUI. - **Run on Linux.** Linux is a first-class platform in OpenLogi. - **Gestures on any button.** Give the gesture role to any physical button — or turn gestures off entirely. - **Plain-text config.** Everything is one TOML file you can sync between machines however you like. - **Script it.** A real CLI alongside the GUI.
